transfer.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy. Every bilinear contributor must lie within 2 m of the closest 0.972 m OBJ source point, and that point must be visible from the recovered camera in the full OBJ mesh.

metadata.label: DRACO mosaic
metadata.coverage: Four DRACO frames from 11 to 1.8 seconds before impact. Closer qualified footprints take precedence; the unseen surface keeps the grid.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Horizons post-impact orbit; observed pole with arbitrary display phase. DART 2022 shape, not a post-impact terrain reconstruction.

controls.label: Shape
controls.notes: The shared neutral gray marks unavailable surface imagery over the released DART v004 global shape. DRACO and LICIACube observations constrain different regions; the closed mesh also contains modeled terrain. It represents the encounter-era body, not a measured post-impact surface. Lighting uses an arbitrary display phase about the observed pole; no photographic texture or albedo is shown. Neutral gray (#808080 sRGB) is a shared display convention, not measured surface color or albedo.

controls.label: DRACO mosaic
controls.notes: Four DRACO frames from 11 to 1.8 seconds before impact. Closer qualified footprints take precedence; the unseen surface keeps the grid. Each image is registered through its archived geometry and checked against the source shape. Brightness is approximately disk-normalized and matched over shared surface patches; shadows remain in the photographs. This is not measured albedo or a post-impact surface.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Color shows source-mesh radius minus a 75 m reference sphere, including the overall flattened shape. It is not height above an equipotential or a map of impact-induced change. Terrain coverage and precision follow the published encounter model. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.

controls.label: Relative albedo
controls.notes: Grayscale shows relative surface brightness from the DART v004 stereophotoclinometry model of the encounter-facing surface before impact. Values are modeled relative albedo, not absolute geometric albedo or a photograph. Facets with positive multi-image uncertainty cover about 31% of the source model area; the ordinary grid marks withheld coverage. Linear display scale: 0.45–1.30.

controls.label: Slope
controls.notes: Slope relative to modeled gravity, including uniform density, rotation and Didymos. This encounter-era model includes inferred terrain; it does not measure impact-driven change.
